title: Walk-in-interview for recruitment of (1) Medical Officer and (9) Specialist posts under various NHM programmes in Kamareddy District on Contract basis. Walk-in-Interview will be conducting to fill up the following posts (1) Medical Officer

GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
O/o. the District Medical & Health Officer,
Kamareddy District
NOTIFICATION
No.679 /E1/DMHO/KMR/2026 Dt:27-10-2026
Walk-in-Interview will be conducted to fill up the following posts (1) Medical
Officer and (9) Specialist posts i.e. Anesthetist, OBG Specialist, Pediatrician and
Psychiatrist posts temporarily on contract basis under NHM to work in Kamareddy
District under the control of the DM&HO, Kamareddy. Interested eligible candidates
may attend the Walk-in-Interview along with all Original certificates and filled in
downloaded application.
Walk-in interview Date : 04-11-2026
Time : 10:30 AM
Venue: IDOC, Room no.105, O/o.DMHO, Kamareddy
Application form can be downloaded from the District Official Website
www.kamareddy.telangana.gov.in.
The fee Rs.500/- is to be paid through D.D in favor of Dist. Medical & Health Officer
kamareddy for processing fee for recruitment.
